title: Administrator Financial Services
salary_text: £24784 - £26500 per year (A 37.5 hour week excellent benefits)
description:
Administrator - Financial Services

Swansea

£24784 - £26500 PA Negotiable on Experience

The Company

Opportunity to join a Financial Services company based in Swansea SA1. The company provide financial and mortgage solutions for a wide variety of customers and are currently looking for an experienced administrator to take on the role of Bridging and Commercial Case Manager.

The Role

This is a permanent position working in the company offices based in Swansea SA1. You will work from 09:00 AM - 05:30 PM Monday to Friday. A 37.5 hour week

The role requires an experienced administrator. Previous experience in the financial services sector is definitely advantageous but not essential.

Duties and responsibilities include:
- Forwarding Applications to lenders
- Sending out application packs to clients
- Ensuring return of applications
- Reviewing of documentation received
- Liaising with lenders regarding application progress and outcome
- Instructing property valuations and chasing for results
- Reviewing valuation reports
- Ensuring all required legal documentation is requested, completed and returned
- Extensive liaison with customers, lenders and internal colleagues
- Making detailed notes on all case files
- Managing required tasks on a daily basis
- Ensuring computer system is up to date with latest information on all cases

Requirements

The successful applicant will have the following skills, experience and qualities:
- Previous experience in a busy administrative position
- Ideally the applicant will have some experience in financial services or another highly structured sector
- Ability to work on a wide variety of tasks simultaneously
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Solid computer skills
- A quick learner, keen to learn new tasks
- Comfortable working in a busy fast paced environment

In return

The company are offering excellent cross over training for experienced administrators which will give the successful applicant good knowledge and exposure to the financial services sector. The salary is based on relevant experience and offers 25 days leave plus public holidays. Once you have successfully completed your probation the following additional benefits are available
- Additional day off for your Birthday
- Pirkx Subscription for Discounts and Cashback
- Company Events
- Company Pension
- Subsidised Private Medical Insurance
- Financial Planning Services

For more information contact Kim Simpson of Work Wales for a confidential discussion

title: BMW Service Advisor
description:
About the role

We have an excellent opportunity available for a highly motivated, experienced Service Advisor to join our team at Sytner BMW Swansea.

As a Sytner Service Advisor, you will provide outstanding customer care and be the vital link between our customers and the workshop. You will inform and consult on vehicle servicing and repairs, and keep the customer up to date at every stage whilst answering any queries they may have. You will liaise with technicians/workshop control about the status of vehicles and ensure that work is completed on time. You will also have the ability to give the best advice on our products and services to our customers to ensure all their vehicle maintenance needs are met.

This is a busy, challenging role where customer care always comes first. You will be driven and self-motivated but take the time to talk to people, build genuine rapport and identify exactly what our customers want and need.

Sytner Service Advisors work a variety of flexible patterns which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

It is essential to have previous experience as a Service Advisor, although this does need to be within a premium brand. Training is provided through our dedicated in-house Learning & Development team and through outstanding manufacturer courses run by BMW to support your development in the role as well as your long-term career aspirations.

You will require excellent organisational and administrative skills along with good attention to detail and must have the ability to manage your time well. A strong customer service background would be beneficial as you will be required to delivering high levels of customer satisfaction in a very busy and demanding environment. Working knowledge of Kerridge would be advantageous, but not essential.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please click here.

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on Developing Talent and Building Careers and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor Customer Service Administrator Customer Support Advisor

Swansea 12.71- 13.00 per hour Monday-Friday Temporary, ongoing

Acorn by Synergie is recruiting a Customer Service Advisor to join a busy team in Swansea. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and customer-focused individual to provide customer service support, process customer orders and carry out general administrative duties.

Introduction

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining strong customer relationships, handling enquiries and supporting the day-to-day operations of the customer service department.

You will need excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a varied workload while delivering a high standard of customer service.

Working Hours & Pay

Monday to Friday, working on an alternating weekly shift pattern:
- Week 1: 9am-5pm.
- Week 2: 8:30am-4:30pm.
- Pay: 12.71- 13.00 per hour.
- Contract: Temporary, ongoing.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
- Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently.
- Handling incoming customer enquiries via telephone and email.
- Providing excellent customer service and building positive customer relationships.
- Liaising with internal departments to ensure orders are processed and delivered on time.
- Updating and maintaining customer records and internal systems.
- Dealing with order queries, delivery issues and general customer requests.
- Completing general administrative duties, including filing, data entry and document management.
- Supporting the wider team with day-to-day administrative and customer service requirements.

Requirements
- Previous experience in a customer service or administration role.
- Excellent communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and good attention to detail.
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and computer-based systems.
- Ability to manage workload effectively and work to deadlines.
- A positive, flexible and proactive approach to work.
- A team player with a strong commitment to delivering excellent customer service.

Interested?

If you have previous customer service or administration experience and are looking for an ongoing temporary opportunity in Swansea, apply today through Acorn by Synergie.

Acorn by Synergie acts as an employment business for the supply of temporary workers.

title: Customer Service Coordinator
company: Randstad Construction and Property - Agency - Temporary
description:
Looking for a customer focused role within a well established and global company?

Can you commit to a long term temporary position with a view to becoming permanent in early 2027.

You will be a key office-based support and responsible for providing assistance across the business.

Your main role will be:
- receiving and processing of customer orders
- communicating with customers - inbound and outbound - in relation to delivery lead times or update on other matters
- liaising with the sales team to help boost sales opportunities
- logging any customer queries and help investigation to resolve

You will need:
- a professional telephone manner
- strong customer focus
- data entry/order processing skills
- good all-round level of PC literacy and willing to learn new systems

Hours of work
- Week 1 - 8:30am - 4:30pm
- Week 2 - 9am - 5pm

Benefits
- 28 days holiday rising to 33 days after 12 weeks (inclusive of public holidays)

title: Reception - Swansea
description:
Job Opportunity: Temporary Receptionist - Swansea

Start date: ASAP

Contract type: Temporary week by week basis

Working days and hours : Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM

Salary: 14.25 an hour

Location: Swansea

Are you a friendly and professional individual with excellent communication skills? Our client, a reputable organisation in the healthcare sector, is seeking a dedicated Receptionist to join their team on a temporary basis in Swansea. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic environment where you can make a difference every day!

Key Responsibilities:

As the Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors. Your role will include:
- Greeting patients and visitors with a warm and welcoming demeanour.
- Managing incoming calls and directing them to the appropriate departments.
- Scheduling appointments and maintaining the appointment calendar.
- Processing patient registrations and ensuring accurate data entry.
- Assisting with administrative tasks to support the healthcare team.
- Maintaining a clean and organised reception area.

What Our Client Offers:
- A vibrant and friendly work atmosphere.
- An opportunity to gain valuable experience in the healthcare industry.
- Competitive pay rates.

Ideal Candidate:

Our client is looking for a Receptionist who possesses:
- Previous experience in a similar role, preferably within healthcare.
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
- Strong organisational abilities and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in using computer systems and software.
- A positive attitude and a passion for providing excellent customer service.

Why Choose This Role?

Make a positive impact on the lives of patients and their families.
Work in a supportive environment where your contributions are valued.
Gain insights into the healthcare sector and enhance your professional skills.

If you are enthusiastic about delivering outstanding service and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this role may be perfect for you!

Application Process:

To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Our client values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Don't miss out on the chance to be part of a dedicated team that prioritises patient care. This is your opportunity to shine in a rewarding position within the healthcare sector!

Location:Swansea
Contract Type: Temporary
